Sessions._comment: MaxConcurrentPerUser caps simultaneous live console sessions per user (0 = unlimited). Redirect/handover continuation legs do not count against it.

RateLimiting._comment: IP-based fixed-window throttles. 'Auth' covers the Identity login/register/password pages; 'Ws' covers the RDP WebSocket relay handshake. Rejected requests get HTTP 429.

DataProtection._comment: MasterKeyPassphrase encrypts the credential keyring at rest and is REQUIRED in Production. Do NOT set it here — supply it out-of-band via the DataProtection__MasterKeyPassphrase environment variable or a secret store.
